description: List your human's recent visits — each with its pages, how it ended, what Cromanion's agent showed or held back, the doubts it read, and the start of the visit's story. Filter by page, outcome, doubt, device, channel and more; page through with `next`. Needs the visits permission, which only your human can give in their console. Everything under `reading` is Cromanion's interpretation, not something the visitor said — report it that way. A visit is readable in full about 30 minutes after the visitor leaves; for who is on the site right now use cromanion_live. The control group is never read, so a doubt filter contains no control visits. Shares a budget of 60 calls an hour with cromanion_visit and cromanion_doubts; every call is on your human's record before it runs. Identifiers in paths are masked (`:id`, `:token`), so products addressed by a number or a code are indistinguishable to a page filter.

agentAction.description: Visits where the agent's intervention was seen, sent, held back, or where the site was still learning. Default `any`.

channel.description: How the visit was acquired — a closed label, never a campaign name.

device.description: The device the visit arrived on.

objection.description: Visits where the model read this doubt at least once. A reading, not a fact.

outcome.description: `left` = ended without your human's conversion. Default `any`.

page.description: Visits that viewed this path — exact, or a prefix ending in `*` (`/products/*`). Pages your human excluded are refused, not answered with zero.

population.description: People (default), AI shopping agents, or both. Crawlers and scripts are never listed.

since.description: ISO date. Visits that STARTED at or after it. Default: 24 hours ago. At most 30 days back.

siteId.description: Which site this call is about. Only needed when your credential covers more than one — cromanion_grants lists them and says whether it is required. Omitting it with several is refused rather than guessed at.

until.description: ISO date. Visits that started before it. Default: now.

visitor.description: First visit, or a returning visitor (a coarse, cookieless reading).

name: cromanion_visits

coverage.description: With a `page` filter, when some visits predate stored page lists: no match there means not recorded, not none.

next.description: Pass as `cursor` for older visits. Null when there are none.

scanned.description: Visits examined. A narrow filter may return fewer than `limit` and still have a `next`.

visits.description: Newest first. Each: visitId, startedAt, closedAt (when Cromanion closed it, ~30 min after the visitor left — not when they left), durationSec, pages, entry, outcome (converted · left · live), conversion, controlGroup, agent `{sent, seen, heldBack, learnMode}`, reading `{objections}` (null = could not have said, [] = read none), summary.
